headline: THE ATLAS WAS ALREADY WRITTEN DOWN: A 188-LINE SCHEDULE FILE NAMES ALL 964 DISPATCHES BY KERNEL, AND q4_matvec IS 401 OF THEM WHILE NORM-AND-RESIDUAL GLUE IS 257

what_the_census_workflow_got_wrong_and_w.the_cause: 23 agents searched qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs (8000+ lines) and the arch census JSON. NONE read qwen38_64_layer_execution_schedule.rs, 188 lines, which NAMES EVERY DISPATCH. The answer was not distributed across a large file -- it was written down in a small one nobody opened.
what_the_census_workflow_got_wrong_and_w.it_was_right_to_refuse_to_reconcile: the workflow explicitly declined to inflate its terms to close the gap, stated 384 as a number, and named the falsifier: 'a per-kernel dispatch histogram from one decode step'. That is exactly this receipt. A decomposition that does not reconcile and SAYS SO is what let the gap be closed by reading one more file.
what_the_census_workflow_got_wrong_and_w.and_one_of_its_derivations_was_circular: it derived '960/64 = 15 exactly' from 964 as though discovering structure. QWEN38_FULL_LAYER_DISPATCHES = 9 + 6 = 15 is a NAMED CONSTANT and 964 is computed FROM it. The 15 was the input, not the finding.

is_964_measured_or_declared.measured: crates/hawking-core/src/metal/mod.rs self.compute_dispatches += 1 at each real dispatch site, surfaced as CommandBufferTiming.dispatches and written to the receipt per step
is_964_measured_or_declared.why_i_checked: a constant equal to the number everyone quotes is the genome-literal defect this campaign already sealed for EBPW. Here the counter is a genuine per-dispatch increment, so the receipt's 964 is a MEASUREMENT that happens to agree with a declared figure -- but the ledger test asserts the CONSTANT equals 964, not that the measurement does, so nothing currently fails if the two ever diverge.
is_964_measured_or_declared.consequence_for_my_own_earlier_claim: 'all three bodies run an identical 964 dispatches, one graph wearing three codecs' SURVIVES -- the counter is real. It would NOT have survived if the receipt had been reading the ledger constant.

the_two_fusions_the_schedule_makes_visib.note: COUNT-LEVEL ONLY. Nothing here is timed, so these are dispatch-deletion candidates and NOT predicted speedups. This program has measured that collapsing dispatches inside one command buffer bought nothing measurable (ACCELERATOR_SYNC_CORRECTION.json refuted launch count), so the expected value of deleting dispatches WITHIN a single CB is precisely what is unknown.

candidate_1_add_residual_into_the_next_r.already_exists: the decode path has a fuse_add_rmsnorm flag and a fused add_rmsnorm kernel
candidate_1_add_residual_into_the_next_r.why_it_is_the_obvious_first_probe: qwen_next_add_residual is 128 dispatches whose output is consumed immediately by qwen80_residual_rmsnorm_f32 in the next schedule slot

candidate_2_gate_up_swiglu.already_exists: mlp_fusion=GateUpSwiglu collapses gate matvec + up matvec + silu_mul to 1

the_two_fusions_the_schedule_makes_visib.the_honest_caveat: both flags ALREADY EXIST in the code. If they are off in the production path the win is available; if they are ON, then the measured 964 already includes them and the schedule file describes the UNFUSED shape -- in which case this atlas describes a graph the runtime does not execute. THAT IS THE NEXT THING TO SETTLE and it is not settled here.

claim_boundary: COUNT ONLY. No time, no bytes, no FLOPs, no synchronization cost -- S031 §3 asks for all of those and this delivers one column of the atlas.

Derived by PARSING A SOURCE FILE, not by instrumenting a run. drain_dispatched_kernel_names() exists at qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs:2234 and would give the ground-truth histogram from a real decode; running it is the check that would confirm the schedule matches execution.
The 48/16 DeltaNet/GQA split is taken from the arch census, not re-derived here.
S031 §3 warns not to assume the most numerous kernel is the most expensive. q4_matvec is 41.6% BY COUNT and its share of TIME is unmeasured -- this receipt must not be cited as a time ranking.

REFUTED_BY_A_REAL_RUN_ONE_BLOCK_LATER.what_i_predicted_would_settle_it: this receipt's own caveat: 'if those flags are already ON in production the measured 964 includes them and this schedule describes the UNFUSED shape -- in which case this atlas describes a graph the runtime does not execute. THAT IS THE NEXT THING TO SETTLE.' It is settled, and the answer is worse than the flag question.
REFUTED_BY_A_REAL_RUN_ONE_BLOCK_LATER.how: crates/hawking-core/examples/qwen38_dispatch_trace.rs already existed and prints the kernel names the runtime ACTUALLY dispatched, harvested from the TCB structural label list. Ran it on the sealed 3.1393 resident at ~/noetic/NOETIC_PARENT_A, 3 generated tokens, FALLBACKS: 0.
REFUTED_BY_A_REAL_RUN_ONE_BLOCK_LATER.result: 14 DISTINCT KERNELS DISPATCHED. Only 7 of them appear in the schedule file.
REFUTED_BY_A_REAL_RUN_ONE_BLOCK_LATER.four_are_variant_renames_and_one_is_not: _f32 -> _tg and _vi -> _vi_simd are the SAME operation under a different threadgroup or simdgroup strategy, so the STRUCTURE may survive the rename. qwen80_silu_mul_f32 -> gk_swiglu_f32 is a DIFFERENT KERNEL, and qwen_affine_q2_group32 appears NOWHERE in the schedule -- that one is not a rename, it is an operation the schedule does not model.
REFUTED_BY_A_REAL_RUN_ONE_BLOCK_LATER.the_body_is_not_uniform_q4_and_that_is_t: the runtime's own census prints tensors=755 affine=192 q4=210 f32=353, and its genome line names mlp_kernel=qwen_q2f_group64, dn_kernel=qwen_uniform_q3_group64, gqa_kernel=qwen_uniform_q3_group128. THE SEALED RESIDENT IS A MIXED-CODEC BODY. The schedule file describes qwen_uniform_q4_group64_matvec in every matvec slot, so it is the schedule for A DIFFERENT BODY.
REFUTED_BY_A_REAL_RUN_ONE_BLOCK_LATER.WHAT_THIS_KILLS: the per-kernel HISTOGRAM in this receipt -- q4_matvec 401, rmsnorm 129, add_residual 128, silu_mul 64 -- is computed from a schedule that names kernels this body does not dispatch. IT IS WITHDRAWN as a description of the sealed resident. It may still describe the uniform-q4 body the schedule was written for; nothing here establishes that either.
REFUTED_BY_A_REAL_RUN_ONE_BLOCK_LATER.WHAT_SURVIVES: the ARITHMETIC 1 + 64*15 + 3 = 964 and the runtime dispatch COUNTER (metal/mod.rs compute_dispatches += 1) are untouched -- this refutes the kernel ATTRIBUTION, not the count. Whether this mixed body also runs 15 dispatches per layer is NOT MEASURED HERE: the trace reports DISTINCT NAMES (14), not per-token counts.
REFUTED_BY_A_REAL_RUN_ONE_BLOCK_LATER.the_lesson_is_one_this_program_keeps_rel: I closed a gap by PARSING A SOURCE FILE and called it an atlas. A schedule file is a DECLARATION; the dispatch trace is a MEASUREMENT; and they disagree on 6 of 13 names plus one operation that is absent entirely. The census workflow refused to reconcile from source and was right; I reconciled from a different source and got a clean 964 that described the wrong graph. A PERFECT RECONCILIATION AGAINST A DECLARATION IS NOT A MEASUREMENT.

pass_reason: the histogram is withdrawn: it describes a uniform-q4 schedule and the sealed resident is a mixed affine/q4/f32 body dispatching seven kernels the schedule never names
